restrictions.terminology: Use 'Stock Tokens' or 'tokenized real-world assets such as Stock Tokens'; do not use 'tokenized stocks' or 'tokenized equities' in external-facing copy.
restrictions.underlying_rights: Stock Tokens provide economic exposure but do not grant legal or beneficial rights in the underlying securities.
restrictions.us_distribution: Do not enable Stock Token offer/sale/delivery flows until qualified legal/compliance review confirms jurisdictional eligibility and transfer restrictions.
restrictions.primary_issuance: Do not assume the app can mint/redeem directly with RHJ; primary issuance is restricted to Authorised Participants.

allowed_before_gate_pass: read-only display of official asset metadata
deployment rehearsal with regulated paths disabled
